title: Project Registration
description: User-global record of one project this install was initialized in. Addressing only: it answers which projects exist and how they are addressed, never what they contain. Project configuration, policy and content stay in each project's own .metaproject/. This record holds no credential material.

projectId.description: Opaque, stable across path changes recorded by an explicit re-registration.

path.description: Absolute project path. Declared explicitly by callers that route to this project; never inferred.

displayName.description: Human-facing label. Safe to render in a transport.

state.description: missing means the path no longer exists; the entry is retained and reported rather than deleted, because a disk being unmounted is not an instruction to forget a project. deregistered is always an explicit operator action.

lastSeenAt.description: Last time the path was confirmed to exist.

transportBindings.description: Opaque references to transport-side bindings for this project, so a transport can reconcile. Contains no transport credential.
